witb_human_alignment.description: What-is-in-the-Box human-judgment alignment across object-box probability ratings, matching the paper's Figure 3 quantitative analysis.

human_correlation.description: Correlation between method object-left probabilities and human object-left ratings.

mean_absolute_error.description: Mean absolute probability error against human object-left ratings; catches methods that preserve rank order but miscalibrate probabilities.

brier_score.description: Mean squared probability error against human object-left ratings; penalizes overconfident probability mistakes more strongly than MAE.

within_scenario_rank_accuracy.description: Pairwise ranking accuracy among objects within each scenario; catches global correlation shortcuts that miss scenario-local judgments.

multimodal_gain_over_best_unimodal.description: Improvement in human-correlation score over the stronger of the audio-only and vision-only artifacts.

joint_gain_over_late_fusion.description: Improvement in human-correlation score over a simple average of audio-only and vision-only probabilities.
